items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m sitting off-camera in the jazz archive at Hamilton College, and I’m very pleased to have my good friend Rick Montalbano here.

ctx.x: Rick Montalbano is the among the most respected musicians in upstate New York. As a full time musician, he has carved out his own niche as a versatile pianist, organist, arranger and band leader. Rick has performed with and employed many of the finest jazz artists in the business including Nick Brignola, Sal Amico, Sal Nistico and Delores Mancuso.

Rick was interviewed in Clinton, New York at the Hamilton College Jazz Archive, on August 12, 2011 by Monk Rowe, director of the Jazz Archive. Romy Britell, the Archive’s transcriptionist, participated briefly in the interview.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m sitting off-camera in the jazz archive at Hamilton College, and I’m very pleased to have my good friend Rick Montalbano here. I’m finally going to be able to talk to you about how the heck you make a living in the music business.
